title: The King of Fighters 2002
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, scores, the teams and their fighters beaten, the fighter on screen with the 41 names, the state of the fight, the power gauges and stocks (1.33, from the RetroAchievements code notes and Seb's captures). The fighting order of each team is read (1.33 test 50), the panel of the desperation moves under a human's name as in '98 and '97.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x66; a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x66; a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

score.note: player 1 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Japan, 1 Korea, 2 China, 3 Holland, 4 Cambodia, 5 Mexico, 6 Italy, 7 Rugal, 8 NESTS. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x858b Game - Screen ID? [8 bits], 0x23 = Select Character 1, 0x2f = Select Character 2); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight (1.31.1, K.O. audit), to confirm in game

_p1_lost.note: P1, fighters already beaten (RetroAchievements 0xa7e4 'P2 rounds won, actually P1 rounds lost'); it does not count the picks on the select screens, unlike '98 (Seb's capture of 18:02)

_p1_ch0.note: P1, team character A (RA 0xa7e7 slot 1, 0xFF on the select screen); RetroAchievements code notes of The King of Fighters 2002, the byte next to the note's address as for its timer and screen (Seb's capture of 2026-11-04)

_p1_cur.note: P1, the fighter on screen (RA 0x8170 Current Character, the same in 2000 and 2001)

_p2_lost.note: P2, fighters already beaten (RA 0xa80a, 'P1 rounds won, actually P2 rounds lost, counts both on draw or time out')

_p2_cur.note: P2, the fighter on screen (RA 0x8370 Current Character)

_p1_seq0.note: P1, the first fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p1_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_p1_seq1.note: P1, the second fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p1_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_p1_seq2.note: P1, the third fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p1_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_p2_seq0.note: P2, the first fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p2_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_p2_seq1.note: P2, the second fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p2_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_p2_seq2.note: P2, the third fighter of the team in fighting order, as a fighter number (0xFF on the select screen); the team as picked is _p2_ch0 to 2, this one is filled by the order select (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 picked ROBERT, JOE, KYO and fought JOE, KYO, ROBERT, P2 MAXIMA, K', WHIP; 1.33 test 50)

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D), read at every frame, for the captures and the moves to come (1.33)

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

_fight_state.note: the state of the fight, at '98's place (2001's RetroAchievements notes, Match State bitflags): 0 before a round (its intro) and between the screens, 2 once GO is given (bit 1, the fight runs), 1 at a K.O. (round finished); no READY state here (Seb's capture of 2026-11-04 18:02). FIGHT ! comes with 2, ROUND n with 0 after 1, as in '98

power.note: P1 power gauge in %, at '98's place, full at 0x40 then a stock (Seb's capture of 18:02: 61 then 0 with a stock)

power_level.note: P1 stocks (RetroAchievements 0x82e2 Gauge Level, at '98's place), 3 at most: POWER MAX

_pow.note: P1 power gauge for the panel: it fills to 0x40, a stock and 0 again (pow_full in hd; Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 0x3C then 0x06 with a stock at 50.0 s, 0x40 then 0 at 79.7 s); the same address as power

_pow_p2.note: P2 power gauge for the panel: it fills to 0x40, a stock and 0 again (pow_full in hd; Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 0x3C then 0x06 with a stock at 50.0 s, 0x40 then 0 at 79.7 s); the same address as power

_stock.note: P1 stocks (RetroAchievements code notes, Gauge Level), up to 3, 4 and 5 for the first, second and third fighter (command.dat); one gone at each desperation move and at MAX (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 71.3 s, 85.2 s, 160.3 s, 198.6 s, the CPU's MAX at 122.7 s and 231.4 s); the same address as power_level

_stock_p2.note: P2 stocks (RetroAchievements code notes, Gauge Level), up to 3, 4 and 5 for the first, second and third fighter (command.dat); one gone at each desperation move and at MAX (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 71.3 s, 85.2 s, 160.3 s, 198.6 s, the CPU's MAX at 122.7 s and 231.4 s); the same address as power_level

_maxv.note: P1 MAX timer, at '98's place: 0x2F when MAX starts (B+C and a stock), down to 0 in about 13 s (maxv_full in hd; Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): the CPU's MAX at 122.7 s, 0x2F then 0x2E, 0x2D...)

_maxv_p2.note: P2 MAX timer, at '98's place: 0x2F when MAX starts (B+C and a stock), down to 0 in about 13 s (maxv_full in hd; Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): the CPU's MAX at 122.7 s, 0x2F then 0x2E, 0x2D...)

_dm.note: P1 state flags, bit 0 set while a desperation move runs, as in '97 (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 0x12 to 0x13 and 0x02 to 0x03 with each of his four desperation moves, the stock going at the same time)

_dm_p2.note: P2 state flags, bit 0 set while a desperation move runs, as in '97 (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:37 (memory recording and 115 screenshots): P1 0x12 to 0x13 and 0x02 to 0x03 with each of his four desperation moves, the stock going at the same time); P2's at P1's address + 0x200 as every other value of this game

select.note: 1 on the character select and the order select (RA 0x858b Screen ID: 0x23 Select Character 1, 0x2f Select Character 2; Seb's capture shows 0x23 then 0xDA 'Order Select/Fighting' for the rest of the game, so the order screen may not be told, to confirm)

round.note: the round of the match, one more at each fighter beaten (1.33)

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes; pow_full: the power gauge full at 0x40; maxv_full: the MAX timer starts at 0x2F; max_buttons: MAX is B+C (command.dat, Activate MAX Mode); max_dm_free: a desperation move in MAX takes no stock and ends MAX, an SDM (A+C or B+D in MAX) takes one (Dream Cancel wiki, command.dat: DM 1 level or MAX, SDM 1 level and MAX) (1.33 test 50)

capture_renames.note: values renamed since Seb's captures of 2026-11-04 (probes confirmed), for tools/replay_capture.py

buttons.note: names of the buttons on the HD screen, as in The King of Fighters '98

moves.note: desperation moves of each fighter (DM), shown under the name when the gauge allows one (1.33 test 50): numpad notation for a fighter facing right, P any punch, K any kick, a letter for one button; from the MAME command.dat (Progetto-SNAPS 0.273, kof2002 entry), its _* lines (the SDM is the same motion with A+C or B+D, done in MAX). A move with the same command and the same move in The King of Fighters '98 or '97 keeps the name it has there; the follow-ups, Yamazaki's four-button move and the hidden ones (HSDM) left out
